gtm_extra.config.title: GTM Extra Settings
gtm_extra.config.sneak.description: Shows the crouching model pose while the local player is flying and sneaking.
gtm_extra.config.outline.description: Experimental. The outline is hidden if any block lies between the camera and player.
gtm_extra.config.item_glow.description: Highlights selected dropped items only when no block obstructs the view.
